entities.summary: Omer Rudolphe Jean, Viscount Vanaudenhove was a Belgian liberal politician, mayor and minister. A businessman, Vanaudenhove was an owner of a shoe factory. He was mayor of Diest, liberal senator (1954–1974), president of the Liberal Party (1961) and president and founder of the PVV-PLP (1961–1969).
